messages:
Elliot: quick postmortem follow-up from the rollout incident. i'm capturing the remediation items we discussed.
Rina: main failure mode = unscoped flag + fast ramp + no immediate client fallback. agreed we need safer defaults and an automated containment chain.
Noah: propose three layers: defaults (schema + CI), runtime detector (paired signals + EWMA smoothing), and ops controls (quarantine + manual rollback).
Kai: concrete defaults: sample_scope default = org_tag; new flags default sample_pct = 1; ramp windows = [5, 15, 60] mins; block ramps >10% without manual approval.
Elliot: detector rules draft: require 2 independent signals from {ewma_error_rate(3m), p95_latency_multiplier(1.5x), fallback_failures} to auto-pause. auto-rollback if pause persists > 10m or error budget burned.
Rina: to reduce noise, use EWMA + min evidence window. page only on auto-rollback, slack notify on pauses.
Noah: SDK changes: add `fallback_variant` and `max_tokens_per_request` per-flag so clients can switch safely when paused. i'll own SDK PR (ETA 2025-05-02).
Kai: i'll own the detector prototype and a simple `canary_health` metric. ETA 2025-05-06.
Elliot: Jess suggested a small sim harness to replay incident traffic. Noah/Jess to add `tools/canary_replay.sh` that runs traffic mixes and asserts thresholds. ETA 2025-05-04.
Rina: sample guard config example (ops readable):
{ "flag_id": "nlp-route-v2", "scope": "org_tag", "tag": "beta", "sample_pct": 1, "ramp_minutes": [5, 15, 60], "auto_pause": { "ewma_mins": 3, "err_pct": 2, "latency_mult": 1.5 }, "auto_rollback": { "pause_mins": 10 } }
Elliot: action items: Kai -> detector + dashboard (due 2025-05-06); Noah -> SDK fallback + token cap PR (due 2025-05-02); Jess -> sim harness + gating infra (due 2025-05-04); Rina -> console quarantine UI + runbook (due 2025-05-08). i'll create cards on the postmortem board.
Rina: add monthly audit to flag ownership: list global flags and owners; auto-tag flags unscoped after 7 days for review.
Noah: add CI regression to ensure templates default to org_tag so new flags aren't global by accident.
Kai: dashboard panels: canary_health_score, flag_exposure_count, pause_events, rollback_events. will mock panels.
Elliot: policy note: require signed risk acknowledgement for global scope. also prevent automatic ramps above 10% without manual approval.
Rina: staging rollout plan: enable `mini` canary for 5 internal tenants for 2 weeks, collect metrics, then widen.
deploy-bot: [ci] canary-guardrails/basic-tests passed on staging.
Elliot: thanks all. i'll schedule a 30m sync next tuesday to review sims and staging metrics. next check-in in 7 days. :thumbsup:
